notes: Left half of 1922 vol 1 plate 3; the gutter is at about x 5790 and everything east of it is the right page seen across the fold (R x ~ L x - 4627, with growing vertical distortion near the fold). Gutter-overlap intersections picked on both halves: McLean Avenue / West 8th Street and McLean Avenue / West 7th Street. Names: GARRARD ST. (no bracket), HORNE ST., McLEAN AV., BUDD ST., POND ST., W. SEVENTH, W. EIGHTH (8TH STREET VIADUCT), W. SIXTH ST., W. FRONT, SKAATS ALLEY. West 8th: the block faces step out east of x~3700 (110' printed near Horne, ~64 ft at Garrard, 60 ft east of McLean); the centreline stays near y 445-466 (viaduct edge lines and trolley line centred). McLean is ~100 ft wide north of 8th (centre x~5502) and 50 ft south of it (centre x~5519); it ends at West 7th (190.5' property line closes it; a sewer continues south). Budd does not continue east of Horne at this alignment (block of lots 127-136 and lot 69 cover its bed; sewers only), so Horne/Budd is a T; Budd reappears east of the C.N.O.&T.P. trestle (x~5000) and runs onto the right half. Garrard ends at Budd (lots 30-35 run straight through). West 6th: the diagonal from the Mill Creek bridge (printed 'W. SIXTH ST.' and '60') is one straight line that continues ESE as W. Front (north face y = 4030 + 0.445(x-2400), straight through the fork); the centreline is taken as north face + 30 ft (98 px vertical), which also centres the trolley line. Of the two solid lines south of the diagonal, the one 44 ft from the north face is a continuous line without ticks (probably a water pipe), the one 60 ft away carries the B&O S.W. track; the 60' label and trolley support the 60 ft reading. E-W West 6th (66') branches due east at the fork; the fork point is where the diagonal centreline meets the E-W centreline (y 4414). Pond Street (30') ends at the diagonal West 6th (T). Horne south of the yard (50') is crossed by tracks and the elevated C.N.O.&T.P. trestle and ends at West 6th (T). Skaats Alley is only 4'-9" wide (x~4383-4401), from the yard to West 6th; an unnamed 4'-6" passage continues on the same line south of 6th to W. Front (not recorded). Railroads, the trestle and the canal bed ignored.
